method: Exhaustive offline model judgment of all120 raw fields, all36 selected card bindings and serialized accepted/withheld fields; not a formal validator, human study, shopper conversion measurement or regraded benchmark. CPU numeric/binding assertions supplement qualitative reading.
scopeLimitations: Three previously used public development demo queries; not unseen generalization.
No budget/hard-constraint case is included; all36 cards are hard-eligible without a budget, not evidence of budget/stock/size reliability.

A frozen base one native AR decision+JSON stream versus B trained rank head and adapted20independent field streams on common resident backbone: adapter, prompt, selection and generation architecture differ.
B generation is structurally source-only neutral; A sees actual query and neutral-copy instruction in same prompt. A water/light headings show request-conditioned category leakage.
Frozen practical/strict gates and all six null usable-readiness values preserved; word-price finding does not retrospectively promote A or establish useful speedup.
Images are deterministic existing gallery bindings; no pixel inspection or image-generation quality claim.
Generic styles, capitalization, repeated field format and neutral heading repetition alone are not false facts.
